Package core

Class Computer

  • java.lang.Object
    • core.Computer
  • All Implemented Interfaces:
    java.lang.Comparable<Computer>, java.lang.Iterable<java.lang.String>
    Direct Known Subclasses:
    Desktop, Notebook
    public class Computer
extends java.lang.Object
implements java.lang.Comparable<Computer>, java.lang.Iterable<java.lang.String>
    The java.Computer class serves as a superclass representing a generic computer. It implements the Comparable interface for comparing computers by brand and the Iterable interface to allow iteration over its fields.

    This class defines common properties shared among different types of computers, such as brand, model, CPU, RAM, and storage.

    Version:
    1.0

    Matvey Kvetko
